g.text: The platform hub gains the three things you only miss after something breaks
AMA + DCR on the dev VMs
tracked: dev and prod VMs, both spoke VNets, the production storage account
5.1 monitor — workspace, agent, data collection rule, CPU alert, KQL
5.2 continuity — VM backup, blob backup, file-level restore, ASR to Norway East
5.3 network — IP Flow Verify, Next Hop, Connection Troubleshoot, flow logs
5.1 needs the dev VMs from Lab 3.2
5.2 needs quota for 2 vCPUs in Norway East before ASR will replicate
5.3 needs platformskycraftswcsa from Lab 4.1 to hold the flow logs
# monitoring is the last module because it can only watch what already exists
